name: Oath of Glory
summary: Paladins destined for heroic deeds and athletic feats.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
features.short: Bonus action: advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, better jumps.
features.summary: As a bonus action, for 10 minutes you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, can carry more, and jump 10 ft. farther.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
features.short: After a Divine Smite, share 2d8 + level temp HP.
features.summary: Immediately after you deal Divine Smite damage, you can use Channel Divinity as a bonus action to distribute 2d8 + your paladin level temporary hit points among creatures within 30 ft.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.short: +10 ft. walking speed; allies who start near you get it too.
features.summary: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft. Allies who start their turn within 5 ft. of you (10 ft. at 18th level) also gain +10 ft. speed until the end of their turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.short: Reaction: add CHA to AC against an attack, then counterattack.
features.summary: When you or a creature within 10 ft. is hit, you can use your reaction to add your Charisma modifier to its AC; if the attack misses, you can make a weapon attack against the attacker. Uses: CHA modifier per long rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.short: Advantage on CHA checks, turn misses into hits, reroll saves.
features.summary: As a bonus action, for 1 minute you have advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn you can turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, and you can reroll a failed save as a reaction. Once per long rest.
